english.title: Obstruct person authorised under section 9 / 10 / 15
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) obstructed **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person legally authorised, whilst

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

was doing an act, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT..), authorised by

(C)_[section 9]_
(D)_[section 10]_
(E)_[section 15]_

of the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 18(1) of and Schedule 4 to the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
obstructed a person whilst doing an act
legally authorised by sections 9, 10 or 15 of the Salmon and Freshwater Fisheries Act 1975

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 9 relates to duty to make and maintain fish passes.
(ii) Section 10 relates to the powers of the water authority to construct and alter fish passes.
(iii) Section 15 relates to the powers of the water authority to use screens etc. to limit movements of salmon and trout.
(iv) See Section 18(2) re. duties of agency/procedure for actions under Section 10 and 15.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
